title: Crystal Anvil
text: Craft at an Arcane Assembly Bench. Keeps vanilla repair, enchantment combining and renaming. Each operation uses one of its 16 durability points. At zero it pauses instead of breaking.
Draws up to 10 mana per second in total from players within five blocks. Every 200 mana restores one durability. Breaking and replacing it does not reset durability.
Sneak-right-click with an empty main hand to preview its 5-block mana absorption radius.
